notes: Not E. coli RNA: these candidates are Tag-Seq PCR libraries of MPRA reporter plasmid DNA pools (human HEK293 enhancer study; plasmid DNA presumably from E. coli). assay_class other; all physiology labels left out (no E. coli culture described). The 0uM/100uM/SeV in titles refers to stimulation of the human cells, not these plasmid pools.

assay_class.q: The same tags were also sequenced from each ransfected plasmid pool to facilitate normalization to plasmid copy numbers.
